description: Translates HTTP to use cases: parses params and body, calls the service, picks the success status. No business rules.
Holds the business rules (use cases) and throws domain errors. Knows nothing about HTTP or storage details.
Loads and stores data behind an interface (`TaskRepository`). No rules; returns plain data.
An error that names a business outcome (`NotFoundError`, `ConflictError`) instead of an HTTP status.
One place at the edge (`app.onError`) maps domain errors to status codes and hides unknown errors behind a 500.
Organizing code by feature (`tasks/`, `users/`), each with its own routes, service and repository.
